==Biography==
Sebastian Alonso Niño Zavaleta was born in Lima, Peru, but spent part of his childhood in the province of Piura. He has been interested in MOBA games since he was a child. He played DotA first and then decided to try League of Legends in 2010. When he was fifteen years old, in Season 2, he reached Diamond I on the North American server.

For many, he is still considered the best jungle in Latin America thanks to his adaptation to the different changes of the metagame, either with tank / initiation or counter-jungle selection.

== Trivia ==
* Previous IGN was '''TheOddOneBlack''' because he was a fan of [[TheOddOne]].
* At the age of 15 he was a well known player from the high Elo NA ranked ladder.
* Received congratulations from [[TheOddOne]], [[Xpecial]], and [[WildTurtle]] when he turned 16 years old.
* Reached rank 1 on the solo queue ladder in season 4 and 5 on the LAN server.
* Reached rank 3 on the solo queue ladder in season 6 on the NA server.
* Reached rank 1 on the solo queue ladder in season 7 on the NA server.

=== Individual Awards ===
* LLA player with the most MVPs in the split (Closing 2022)
* LLA Most Weekly MVPs in his role in the split x2 (Opening 2020, Closing 2020)
* LLA Most Player of the Week awards in the split (Closing 2020)
